title: Case: Grocery order marked delivered with a doorstep photo the customer disputes
context: A weekly grocery order from Brineleaf Pantry, including chilled items, is marked delivered. The customer has been through the merchant's live chat and has now written to the desk.
initial_request: So to recap my evening. Tracker says delivered. Chat one tells me to ask the neighbours. Chat drops. Chat two wants my order number all over again. Chat drops because I dared to look at another tab. Chat three finally admits that is not my door, then tells me he can't do anything about it from chat, and the window closes on me. It is now gone seven. There is a week of food including chicken and the kids' yoghurts sat in a stranger's porch and I have nothing in for tomorrow's packed lunches. I am not knocking on a stranger's door in the dark to ask for my chicken back. Who actually sorts this out?

events.to: Roisin Avelar, recipient; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: DL-968 (Brineleaf order BP-968) delivered 17:38. Left in porch. Photo reference PH-968-1.

events.to: Roisin Avelar, recipient; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: How did we do? Rate today's delivery in two taps and get 15% off your next shop. Plus: winter soups are back, and new this week, sourdough crumpets. You are receiving this because you opted in to offers. Unsubscribe any time in your account.

Order BP-968. Your tracker says delivered, left in porch. I don't have a porch. The photo is a green door with a 14 on it. I live at 41 Tannery Walk. I have just spent forty minutes on Brineleaf's live chat and had to keep the window open the whole time or lose my place, and I lost it twice anyway. Nothing has been arranged.
Thanks for your message. Messages are answered in the order received. Our busiest times are 17:00 to 20:00. For quick answers try the help pages.

DL-968: the recipient at 41 Tannery Walk says photo PH-968-1 shows a door numbered 14 with a porch, and she has no porch. Can you check the stop record and tell me whether the parcel can be retrieved tonight?

Chat CH-77120 summary for order BP-968. Customer reports order left at the wrong property. Agent reviewed photo PH-968-1: it shows a door numbered 14 with an enclosed porch. The order address is 41 Tannery Walk, no porch noted. Agent accepts the photo does not match the order address. Chat agents cannot raise replacements, refunds or redeliveries. A request must go to Replacement authorisations by Email with the order number and photo reference. Session ended: customer inactive.
DL-954, pallet for Marsh Lane Stores: rebooked to Thursday 12 November AM at the consignee's request. No action needed from the desk, for your records only.
Your October statement is now available in the Business portal. Queries on any line should be raised within 14 days. This is an automated notice, please do not reply.

And while I'm at it, last month's order had substitutions I never agreed to, oat milk instead of semi-skimmed and some fancy butter, and nobody answered me about that either. Not the point tonight, I know. Same story though isn't it.

DL-968: driver has finished for the day. Stop GPS gets reviewed by Delivery investigations if a case is opened, that's not tonight. We can't send anyone back out this evening, and drivers don't collect from a third-party address without an investigations instruction anyway.

events.from: Corn Exchange locker bank, pickup-point staff
events.body: Notice to all desks: locker bank closed for maintenance Sunday 8 November 06:00 to 12:00. Parcels already in lockers are unaffected.

So to recap my evening. Tracker says delivered. Chat one tells me to ask the neighbours. Chat drops. Chat two wants my order number all over again. Chat drops because I dared to look at another tab. Chat three finally admits that is not my door, then tells me he can't do anything about it from chat, and the window closes on me. It is now gone seven. There is a week of food including chicken and the kids' yoghurts sat in a stranger's porch and I have nothing in for tomorrow's packed lunches. I am not knocking on a stranger's door in the dark to ask for my chicken back. Who actually sorts this out?

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask Replacement authorisations to decide a replacement or refund for BP-968, citing the photo reference and the chat agent's finding, and tell them what the customer has been through tonight.

must: Sends Replacement authorisations the order number BP-968 and photo reference PH-968-1 and asks for their decision on a replacement or refund.
States the evidence: the photo shows a door numbered 14 with a porch, the order address is 41 Tannery Walk, and the chat agent accepted the mismatch (CH-77120).

Tells them what she has already been through and what it leaves her with: about forty minutes and three dropped chat sessions for evidence that was there from the start, and a household with no food in for tomorrow, so they act tonight and contact her directly.
Says the carrier will not retrieve the order this evening, so recovery of the original is not an option to wait for.
must_not: Asks or suggests that Roisin go to number 14, or to any neighbour, to look for or collect the order.
Promises a replacement, a refund or a redelivery time.
Sends her back to live chat, or replies to her only that the matter is being looked into.
Says anything about whether the food would still be safe to eat if it were recovered.
Brings the substitution complaint, DL-954, the billing statement or the locker notice into the message.
expected.reference_message: Order BP-968 / DL-968, weekly grocery order including chilled items, for Roisin Avelar at 41 Tannery Walk. The carrier marked it delivered at 17:38 today, left in porch, photo reference PH-968-1. The photo shows a door numbered 14 with an enclosed porch. Her address is number 41 and has no porch. Your chat agent reviewed the photo and accepted that it does not match the order address (chat CH-77120), and noted that only your team can raise a replacement or refund. Plover Arc Dispatch have told me the driver has finished and nobody can retrieve the order this evening. Please decide a replacement or refund for BP-968 and contact her directly tonight if you can. It took her about forty minutes and three chat sessions that dropped on her to get the photo looked at, and she now has no food in for the household tomorrow, including the children's lunches. I have promised her nothing and have not asked her to go to the other property.

rationale: Among the newsletter, statement, locker notice, another shipment and an old substitution grumble, three events decide it: the delivery notice with its photo reference, the chat summary accepting the mismatch and naming Replacement authorisations by Email as the only route, and Dispatch saying nothing can be retrieved tonight. The desk's job is one plain request to that team. Sending her to a stranger's door or back to chat repeats the failures she has just listed.

review.note: Blind answer reaches the right team and channel but carries the old substitutions complaint into the urgent request, which the key prohibits for this noise case.
